+namespace ShipmentTracker.Endpoints;

+public static class ShipmentEndpoints
+{
+    public static void MapShipmentEndpoints(this WebApplication app)
+    {
+        var group = app.MapGroup("/api/shipments").RequireAuthorization();
+
+        // Get all shipments (dispatchers)
+        group.MapGet("/", async (ApplicationDbContext db, HttpContext http) =>
+        {
+            var user = http.User;
+            if (!user.IsInRole("Dispatcher"))
+                return Results.Forbid();
+
+            var shipments = await db.Shipments
+                .OrderByDescending(s => s.ShippedDate)
+                .Select(s => new ShipmentDto
+                {
+                    Id = s.Id,
+                    TrackingNumber = s.TrackingNumber,
+                    Origin = s.Origin,
+                    Destination = s.Destination,
+                    Status = s.Status,
+                    ShippedDate = s.ShippedDate,
+                    EstimatedDelivery = s.EstimatedDelivery,
+                    ActualDelivery = s.ActualDelivery,
+                    CustomerEmail = s.CustomerEmail,
+                    RecipientName = s.RecipientName,
+                    Description = s.Description
+                })
+                .ToListAsync();
+
+            return Results.Ok(shipments);
+        });
+
+        // Get shipments for current customer
+        group.MapGet("/my", async (ApplicationDbContext db, HttpContext http, UserManager<ApplicationUser> userManager) =>
+        {
+            var user = await userManager.GetUserAsync(http.User);
+            if (user is null) return Results.Unauthorized();
+
+            var shipments = await db.Shipments
+                .Where(s => s.CustomerEmail == user.Email)
+                .OrderByDescending(s => s.ShippedDate)
+                .Select(s => new ShipmentDto
+                {
+                    Id = s.Id,
+                    TrackingNumber = s.TrackingNumber,
+                    Origin = s.Origin,
+                    Destination = s.Destination,
+                    Status = s.Status,
+                    ShippedDate = s.ShippedDate,
+                    EstimatedDelivery = s.EstimatedDelivery,
+                    ActualDelivery = s.ActualDelivery,
+                    CustomerEmail = s.CustomerEmail,
+                    RecipientName = s.RecipientName,
+                    Description = s.Description
+                })
+                .ToListAsync();
+
+            return Results.Ok(shipments);
+        });
+
+        // Track by tracking number
+        group.MapGet("/track/{trackingNumber}", async (string trackingNumber, ApplicationDbContext db) =>
+        {
+            var shipment = await db.Shipments
+                .Where(s => s.TrackingNumber == trackingNumber)
+                .Select(s => new ShipmentDto
+                {
+                    Id = s.Id,
+                    TrackingNumber = s.TrackingNumber,
+                    Origin = s.Origin,
+                    Destination = s.Destination,
+                    Status = s.Status,
+                    ShippedDate = s.ShippedDate,
+                    EstimatedDelivery = s.EstimatedDelivery,
+                    ActualDelivery = s.ActualDelivery,
+                    RecipientName = s.RecipientName,
+                    Description = s.Description
+                })
+                .FirstOrDefaultAsync();
+
+            return shipment is null ? Results.NotFound() : Results.Ok(shipment);
+        });
+
+        // Update shipment status (dispatchers only)
+        group.MapPut("/{id:int}/status", async (int id, UpdateStatusRequest request, ApplicationDbContext db, HttpContext http) =>
+        {
+            if (!http.User.IsInRole("Dispatcher"))
+                return Results.Forbid();
+
+            var shipment = await db.Shipments.FindAsync(id);
+            if (shipment is null) return Results.NotFound();
+

+            if (request.Status == ShipmentStatus.Delivered)

+

The app is built and ready. Here's a summary of what was created:

**ShipmentTracker** — a Blazor Web App using **Interactive Auto** render mode:

| Requirement | Solution |
|---|---|
| Fast first load | Server-side prerendering (SSR) on initial visit |
| Snappy after load | WebAssembly takes over — no server round-trips |
| Worldwide users | Auto mode: Server renders first paint fast, then WASM runs locally |
| Interactive controls | All pages use `@rendermode InteractiveAuto` (default via template) |
| Individual accounts | ASP.NET Core Identity with roles (Dispatcher/Customer) |

**Key features:**
- **`/dispatcher`** — Dispatchers see all shipments, filter by destination/status, create new shipments, update status via dropdown
- **`/my-shipments`** — Customers view their shipments with progress bars and track by number
- **API** at `/api/shipments` with role-based authorization
- Seeded with demo data and two users:
  - `dispatcher@shiptrack.com` / `Dispatch1!`
  - `customer@example.com` / `Customer1!`

Run with:
```bash
cd ShipmentTracker/ShipmentTracker && dotnet run
```
